canonicalization.checkpoint_hash_scope: For Checkpoint only, remove top-level checkpoint_hash and record_hash, Unicode-normalize every string to NFC, canonicalize the remaining Checkpoint with RFC 8785 JCS, hash the resulting UTF-8 bytes with SHA-256, and encode as lowercase hexadecimal.
canonicalization.head_hash_scope: For StateHead only, remove top-level head_hash and record_hash, Unicode-normalize every string to NFC, canonicalize the remaining StateHead with RFC 8785 JCS, hash the resulting UTF-8 bytes with SHA-256, and encode as lowercase hexadecimal.
canonicalization.intrinsic_dependency_order: For TransactionRecord, Checkpoint, SnapshotManifest, and StateHead, compute the typed hash first; then compute record_hash over the complete record including that typed hash and excluding only record_hash.
canonicalization.number_domain: I-JSON compatible; durable numeric fields are integers within the IEEE-754 safe-integer range.
canonicalization.provider_concurrency_tokens: TRANSIENT_ONLY; excluded from durable records and all canonical hash inputs
canonicalization.record_hash_scope: Remove the top-level record_hash property, canonicalize the remaining record with RFC 8785 after NFC normalization, then hash the UTF-8 bytes.
canonicalization.snapshot_hash_scope: For SnapshotManifest only, remove top-level snapshot_hash and record_hash, Unicode-normalize every string to NFC, canonicalize the remaining SnapshotManifest with RFC 8785 JCS, hash the resulting UTF-8 bytes with SHA-256, and encode as lowercase hexadecimal.
canonicalization.transaction_hash_scope: For TransactionRecord only, remove top-level transaction_hash and record_hash, Unicode-normalize every string to NFC, canonicalize the remaining TransactionRecord with RFC 8785 JCS, hash the resulting UTF-8 bytes with SHA-256, and encode as lowercase hexadecimal.

capability_registry_binding_policy.binding_shape: CapabilityRegistryBinding validates identity, semantic version, canonical provider artifact ID, exact artifact-byte SHA-256, and the artifact's exact self-hash contract without embedding any current Registry hash in this schema bundle.
capability_registry_binding_policy.checkpoint_economy: Checkpoint carries no duplicate Registry binding. Checkpoint.latest_transaction_id resolves exactly to TransactionRecord.result_capability_registry, while the authoritative StateHead binds the same result directly.
capability_registry_binding_policy.cycle_rule: CapabilityRegistryBinding.registry_hash is an external artifact hash. The schema validates its shape but contains no current Registry hash constant; therefore Registry bytes may bind the schema hash without a Registry-schema hash cycle.
capability_registry_binding_policy.explicit_transition_rule: A Registry A to Registry B difference is permitted only for operation_mode MAINTENANCE with an explicit SUPERSEDE action targeting ND_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY, a PASS substantive review, exact independent validation of B, execution authority equal to the parent StateHead Registry A, and resulting StateHead authority equal to B.
capability_registry_binding_policy.genesis_rule: INITIALIZE requires execution_capability_registry and result_capability_registry to be byte-equivalent bindings to the exact final pre-genesis Registry authorizing Genesis.
capability_registry_binding_policy.ordinary_update_rule: Ordinary UPDATE requires execution_capability_registry to equal the parent StateHead.capability_registry and result_capability_registry to equal execution_capability_registry.
capability_registry_binding_policy.pregenesis_revision_rule: Before any production durable adoption, historical Registry versions may remain recoverable revisions of the same provider artifact. No successor artifact is required solely for this pre-genesis repair.
capability_registry_binding_policy.projection_rule: Copied Notion, handoff, display, report, or historical version literals never override an exact durable CapabilityRegistryBinding.
capability_registry_binding_policy.published_dependency_rule: PUBLISHED_STATE_REFERENCED_REGISTRY_IS_IMMUTABLE: after a Registry version/hash is referenced by a PUBLISHED TransactionRecord or StateHead, its exact artifact bytes are an immutable durable dependency; later material configuration change requires a preserved successor artifact and explicit maintenance transaction.
capability_registry_binding_policy.state_head_authority: StateHead.capability_registry equals the publishing TransactionRecord.result_capability_registry and is sufficient to resolve the exact active capability configuration.
capability_registry_binding_policy.transaction_execution_authority: TransactionRecord.execution_capability_registry identifies the exact Registry under which the transaction is authorized and evaluated.
capability_registry_binding_policy.transaction_result_authority: TransactionRecord.result_capability_registry identifies the exact Registry adopted by the resulting durable state.

cross_record_constraints.rule: Every record ID is globally unique within its record type and is never reused.
Every ID reference resolves to an existing record of the declared type or to a final-Registry-resolved canonical artifact.

Every hash-valued durable field has exactly one classification and one provenance in hash_contracts. Every computed durable hash has declared source bytes, canonicalization, exclusion scope, algorithm, and encoding; an unclassified or multiply classified field is BLOCKED_UNDECLARED_HASH_SEMANTICS.
Supersession, retraction, split, merge, model-version, checkpoint, and head lineage graphs are acyclic.
A lifecycle of SUPERSEDED or RETRACTED has a resolvable successor or retraction transaction and a preserved reversal/reopening condition.
valid_to is absent or not earlier than valid_from; recorded_at and publication times do not contradict transaction order.
Each KnowledgeClaim support_ref resolves to a SourceRecord or admitted KnowledgeClaim; dependency_group prevents derivative evidence from being counted as independent.
Each ConditionEdge resolves to admitted claim_ids and evidence_refs; exact Paṭṭhāna classifications retain the exact supporting locator.
Each ModelRecord resolves all claim_ids and edge_ids and increments model_version for every material model or Conditions Map change.

The same packet_id or idempotency_key never maps to conflicting packet_hash values or hash contracts; packet_hash is the exact external packet-artifact hash under ND-PACKET-HASH-EXACT-BYTES-V1, and exact replay returns the prior result without a new transaction.

For every new or changed transaction, parent checkpoint and expected logical head identity/hash equal the authoritative values at stage and publication. A non-null expected_head_hash equals exactly the referenced authoritative StateHead.head_hash; INITIALIZE requires expected_head_id and expected_head_hash null plus proven absence. A fresh provider revision is obtained and used only as transient requiredRevisionId metadata for the conditional publication call. Exception: only an XRC-047 authorized recovery boundary may separate provider expected_head_* from logical parent_checkpoint; the boundary must bind both exact parents and XRC-048 applies.
Competing native Google Docs head publications using the same transient requiredRevisionId produce exactly one winner; every loser is CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT and makes no authoritative change.
writer_operation_id is globally unique and maps to one immutable proposed operation and one recoverable outcome.

A Checkpoint latest_transaction_id resolves to a TransactionRecord. For Schema 1.7.0+ an active StateHead may reference a COMMIT_INTENT transaction; successful provider CAS plus exact StateHead/latest-bundle readback confers effective PUBLISHED_BY_STATEHEAD status without mutating the immutable transaction. Legacy PUBLISHED records remain valid only under their original Schema. Every non-null snapshot reference resolves exactly.

Exactly one ACTIVE StateHead exists after Genesis. StateHead.checkpoint_hash equals exactly the referenced Checkpoint.checkpoint_hash; transaction identity, writer operation identity, logical head hash, record hash, and canonical bytes match the conditionally published content. previous_head_hash equals exactly the referenced predecessor StateHead.head_hash, or both predecessor fields are null at Genesis. Provider revision tokens remain external transient concurrency metadata.
The head advances only after exact staged-object and transaction readback; an ambiguous or nonmatching outcome is QUARANTINED.
Exactly one primary open Frontier question exists unless governing work is complete or durably blocked.
Every CREATE action has a CreationDecision proving REUSE and EXTEND insufficient and records ownership, lifecycle, retirement, and reversal cost.
Every material action has a structurally complete justification and passes authorized substantive proportionality review; structural completeness alone never admits it.
No record, source, tool result, projection, or imported memory can modify governance or permissions except through the authenticated governance path resolved by the final Registry.
StateHead head_hash follows the declared head_hash intrinsic contract exactly; StateHead record_hash is then computed under record_hash_scope and includes the already-computed head_hash.

Every SnapshotManifest member resolves to the exact durable record type and ID whose canonical record_hash equals the member record_hash; members are unique, sorted by record_type then record_id, and SnapshotManifest records cannot recursively be members. snapshot_hash follows snapshot_hash_scope and record_hash follows record_hash_scope.

NO SNAPSHOT WITHOUT MATERIAL SNAPSHOT TRIGGER. SnapshotManifest creation requires at least one non-empty member, one enumerated canonical trigger, structurally complete sufficient-ground and proportionality justification, material benefit, and minimum necessary complexity. Genesis alone is not a trigger and never justifies an empty snapshot.

Checkpoint.checkpoint_hash follows checkpoint_hash_scope exactly. Checkpoint record_hash is computed second under record_hash_scope and includes the already-computed checkpoint_hash. StateHead.checkpoint_hash is a referenced typed hash, never a StateHead computation.
TransactionRecord.transaction_hash follows transaction_hash_scope exactly. TransactionRecord record_hash is computed second under record_hash_scope and includes the already-computed transaction_hash.

The five intrinsic durable hashes are record_hash, transaction_hash, checkpoint_hash, snapshot_hash, and head_hash. Each uses Unicode NFC, RFC 8785 JCS, SHA-256, and lowercase hexadecimal with its declared exclusion set; no computed hash includes itself and no circular hash dependency is permitted.

Every referenced hash resolves to exactly its declared typed or generic record field. Every external hash resolves to its declared artifact/content bytes and hash contract. Checkpoint or TransactionRecord JCS scopes never apply to external content or artifact hashes.

Every set-like array covered by a typed hash follows typed_hash_array_ordering. Transaction proposed_actions and material-action reasoning/evidence lists preserve declared semantic sequence. Arbitrary set ordering is BLOCKED_INTEGRITY.

TransactionRecord.changed_ids and staged_object_hashes bind one-to-one to the exact staged durable objects and their generic record_hash values. The current TransactionRecord and StateHead are excluded from that staged set so transaction_hash cannot acquire a self or head-last cycle.

Every CapabilityRegistryBinding resolves to the exact canonical_artifact_id bytes. registry_id, registry_version, registry_hash, and hash_contract equal the parsed Registry identity, semantic version, SHA-256 of exact bytes, and self_hash_contract. Missing, stale, malformed, mismatched, or projection-only authority is BLOCKED_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_BINDING.

INITIALIZE requires identical execution and result Registry bindings. Ordinary UPDATE requires execution binding equal to the exact parent StateHead capability_registry and result binding equal to execution binding. Every published StateHead capability_registry equals its publishing TransactionRecord result binding.

A Registry transition is never implicit. A difference between execution and result bindings is valid only for MAINTENANCE with an explicit SUPERSEDE proposed action whose target_id is ND_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY, PASS substantive review, exact validated successor Registry, and parent/result StateHead bindings A/B respectively. Any unexplained, stale, display-induced, historical, malformed, or hash-mismatched transition is blocked.

PUBLISHED_STATE_REFERENCED_REGISTRY_IS_IMMUTABLE. Exact Registry bytes referenced by published durable state are permanent recovery dependencies. A later material configuration change preserves prior bytes, creates an exact successor only when in-place mutation would destroy a published dependency, and adopts it through the explicit maintenance transition in XRC-032.

CapabilityRegistryBinding.registry_hash is classified once as EXTERNAL_CONTENT_OR_ARTIFACT_HASH with EXTERNAL_ARTIFACT provenance. TransactionRecord and StateHead typed/generic hashes include their complete Registry bindings under existing intrinsic scopes. No current Registry hash is a schema constant and no Registry-binding hash cycle is permitted.

Checkpoint does not duplicate CapabilityRegistryBinding because latest_transaction_id resolves exactly to TransactionRecord.result_capability_registry and any authoritative StateHead directly binds the same result. Failure of either traversal is BLOCKED_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_BINDING; copied projections never repair it.

StateHead requires exactly one DurableRecordStoreBinding with store_id ND-DURABLE-RECORD-STORE, provider GOOGLE_DRIVE, storage_model IMMUTABLE_TRANSACTION_BUNDLE_CHAIN_V1, exact root_folder_id, and exact latest_bundle DriveArtifactBinding. Checkpoint and TransactionRecord do not duplicate it.

Every EmbeddedDurableRecord is closed and independently schema-valid; record_type, record_id, and record_hash equal the embedded record's type, logical ID, stored generic hash, and recomputed generic hash.

Every DurableTransactionBundle contains exactly one matching TransactionRecord, exactly one resulting Checkpoint, every staged changed durable record, and no unexplained material record. StateHead is forbidden. Snapshot records and members are extras only under an exact material snapshot trigger.

INITIALIZE requires parent_bundle null. Every non-Genesis bundle requires parent_bundle byte-equivalent to the exact latest_bundle binding in the parent authoritative StateHead. Bundle ancestry is acyclic. Exception: only an XRC-047 authorized recovery boundary may set parent_bundle to the validated recovery-parent carrier rather than the observed CAS predecessor latest_bundle; the divergence must be manifest-bound.

DurableTransactionBundle bytes are exactly Unicode NFC then RFC 8785 JCS then UTF-8 with no BOM or trailing bytes. records are sorted by record_type then record_id after NFC using UTF-8 byte order; duplicate logical entries are rejected.

bundle_id equals transaction_id plus :BUNDLE and bundle created_at equals the embedded TransactionRecord staged_at. Therefore retries of one logical transaction produce byte-identical bundle content independent of Drive-assigned provider ID.

Authoritative restart begins only from the CAS-validated StateHead and exact latest_bundle artifact ID/hash, validates every traversed bundle, and follows only exact parent_bundle IDs/hashes. Drive search, filenames, folder-name inference, Notion, handoffs, projections, and conversation memory are forbidden resolver dependencies. An XRC-047 successor may cross exactly one manifest-bound recovery discontinuity to its validated FULL_DURABLE_STATE anchor after verifying governance, ledger, manifest and excluded provenance.

PUBLISHED_STATE_REFERENCED_BUNDLE_IS_IMMUTABLE. Every StateHead-referenced bundle and ancestor remains byte-identical and recoverable by exact provider ID/hash under the bound store root; mismatch, absence, noncanonical bytes, or ancestry cycle is BLOCKED_INTEGRITY. Artifacts explicitly excluded by an XRC-047 recovery boundary remain immutable provenance but are not ancestors of the repaired successor chain.

An ambiguous bundle create, failed StateHead CAS, or stale concurrent writer cannot create authority. Schema 1.7.0+ immutable bundles embed transaction_state=COMMIT_INTENT with cas_verdict=PENDING and no self-asserted write/readback/publication timestamps. An unreferenced exact-ID bundle remains an orphan intent. Only successful provider CAS plus exact StateHead and latest-bundle readback creates authority; no post-CAS bundle mutation is permitted.

The current bundle excludes StateHead and its own provider ID/hash, so the physical graph is acyclic: finalize logical records, canonicalize bundle, write/read back exact bundle bytes, capture Drive artifact ID/hash, construct StateHead, then conditionally publish StateHead last.

Every new record and bundle resolves SchemaBinding.bundle_version and bundle_hash to one exact immutable Schema artifact. Historical records are validated only against their own original immutable Schema binding; an incoherent version/hash pair is nonadmissible provenance, never silently reinterpreted.

EXPLICIT_LINEAGE_DISCONTINUITY is permitted only when a non-null RecoveryBoundary exactly binds a Savva-authorized governance decision, immutable recovery manifest, admission ledger, independently qualified FULL_DURABLE_STATE recovery parent, observed provider CAS parent, and complete nonadmissible-record list. The exception is limited to that exact boundary and does not relax ordinary invariants elsewhere.

For XRC-047 only: TransactionRecord.expected_head_id/hash and successor StateHead.previous_head_id/hash equal the observed provider CAS parent; TransactionRecord.parent_checkpoint and successor Checkpoint.parent_checkpoint equal the validated recovery-parent checkpoint; successor bundle.parent_bundle equals the validated recovery-parent carrier bundle. These two parent roles must never be conflated.

Every post-anchor effect named by the recovery manifest has exactly one admission-ledger disposition READMIT, ABSENT, or DEFER. READMIT binds independently validated current evidence; ABSENT and DEFER are not admitted. Nonadmissible historical records are PROVENANCE_ONLY and forbidden from SnapshotManifest.members.

A recovery-boundary successor FULL_DURABLE_STATE snapshot contains only independently schema-valid admitted durable records. It may reuse the exact validated anchor member set and must never insert rewritten variants of excluded historical records. The recovery transaction/checkpoint remain represented by the new latest bundle even when not recursively included as snapshot members.

Cold recovery of an XRC-047 successor validates the current StateHead, successor Registry and Schema, exact latest bundle, exact recovery-boundary evidence, then follows the successor parent_bundle directly to the validated recovery anchor. Traversal of skipped defective physical edges is forbidden and no new Genesis is inferred.

STATEHEAD_PROVIDER_COMMIT_IS_EXTERNAL_TO_HASHED_RECORDS. For Schema 1.7.0+ the immutable bundle carries COMMIT_INTENT. The candidate StateHead carries only the publication protocol declaration, never a self-proof of its future CAS/readback. Effective PUBLISHED_BY_STATEHEAD status exists only after requiredRevisionId CAS succeeds and the active provider StateHead plus exact latest bundle are read back and match the candidate hashes. CAS failure leaves the bundle an unauthoritative COMMIT_INTENT orphan.

NO_SELF_PROOF_IN_HASHED_STATE. A TransactionRecord or StateHead must not hash a claim that its own future provider write, CAS, or exact readback has already succeeded. Same-object provider-result facts live outside the hashed candidate and are established by the actual provider response/readback; only predecessor/external qualification facts may be embedded.

durable_record_store_policy.acyclicity: The bundle excludes StateHead and does not contain its own Drive artifact ID/hash. Upload and exact readback therefore precede StateHead construction without a physical hash cycle.
durable_record_store_policy.artifact_identity: Exact GOOGLE_DRIVE artifact_id plus SHA-256 artifact_hash of exact bytes; filename and folder path are informational and search is never authority.
durable_record_store_policy.bundle_bytes: Unicode NFC then RFC 8785 JCS then UTF-8, no BOM and no trailing bytes; records are sorted by record_type then record_id using NFC UTF-8 byte order.
durable_record_store_policy.bundle_identity: bundle_id equals transaction_id plus :BUNDLE; created_at equals the embedded TransactionRecord.staged_at so retries of one logical transaction produce identical bytes.
durable_record_store_policy.bundle_membership: Exactly one matching TransactionRecord, exactly one resulting Checkpoint, every staged changed record, and only snapshot records/members justified by an actual snapshot trigger; StateHead is forbidden from its own bundle.
durable_record_store_policy.genesis_parent: INITIALIZE requires parent_bundle null. Every successor requires parent_bundle equal to the exact latest_bundle binding in its parent StateHead.
durable_record_store_policy.orphan_policy: An ambiguous create, failed head CAS, or stale concurrent writer never advances authority. Exact-ID candidates not referenced by the winning StateHead are WRITTEN_UNPUBLISHED orphans and may be quarantined or garbage-collected later.
durable_record_store_policy.published_immutability: PUBLISHED_STATE_REFERENCED_BUNDLE_IS_IMMUTABLE: bytes, provider identity, and bound root containment of every StateHead-referenced bundle and ancestor remain recoverable and are never overwritten in place.
durable_record_store_policy.resolver: Read the authoritative StateHead; validate schema, hashes, and CAS provenance; fetch latest_bundle by exact artifact_id; verify exact hash/MIME/canonical bytes; resolve the exact embedded record; otherwise follow exact parent_bundle bindings until found or Genesis; any failure is BLOCKED_INTEGRITY.
durable_record_store_policy.search_prohibition: Global Drive search, filename inference, folder-name inference, Notion, handoffs, conversation memory, and copied projections never participate in authoritative recovery.
durable_record_store_policy.snapshot_policy: Snapshots use the same bundle chain. A legitimate snapshot bundle may embed its SnapshotManifest and exact members; without a material trigger no snapshot records or duplicate members are allowed.
durable_record_store_policy.state_head_root: StateHead.durable_record_store is the sole physical recovery root. Checkpoint and TransactionRecord do not duplicate DurableRecordStoreBinding.

ND-CONTENT-HASH-EXACT-BYTES-V1.source_bytes: Exact acquired source-content or source-snapshot bytes bound by canonical_locator, exact_locators, edition_or_version, and artifact_revision.

ND-PACKET-HASH-EXACT-BYTES-V1.source_bytes: Exact immutable research-packet artifact bytes identified by packet_id and idempotency_key.

hash_contracts.acyclicity_rule: No intrinsic hash includes itself. Typed hashes exclude themselves and record_hash; generic record_hash is computed second and may include the typed hash. Referenced hashes must already exist or be staged without a reverse hash dependency. DurableTransactionBundle excludes StateHead and its own provider artifact ID/hash; the external DriveArtifactBinding is created only after bundle bytes exist and is then included in StateHead.
hash_contracts.completeness_invariant: NO COMPUTED DURABLE HASH WITHOUT DECLARED SOURCE BYTES + CANONICALIZATION + EXCLUSION SCOPE + ALGORITHM + ENCODING.

field_classification.declared_source: Final Registry canonical_hash for the exact ND_DURABLE_STATE_SCHEMA_BUNDLE artifact under artifact_hash_contract.

Exact bytes of CapabilityRegistryBinding.canonical_artifact_id under the exact self-hash contract copied in CapabilityRegistryBinding.hash_contract; Registry ID and semantic version must match the parsed artifact content.

Exact raw UTF-8 JSON artifact bytes fetched by DriveArtifactBinding.artifact_id under its copied exact-byte hash_contract; for transaction bundles those bytes must also equal NFC-normalized RFC 8785 JCS with no BOM or trailing bytes.
SourceRecord.content_hash_contract_id = ND-CONTENT-HASH-EXACT-BYTES-V1; null only when content_hash is null.
The exact head_hash of expected_head_id's authoritative StateHead; null only for INITIALIZE against proven head absence.
The exact packet artifact under packet_hash_contract_id = ND-PACKET-HASH-EXACT-BYTES-V1.
Exactly the sorted record_hash set of the staged durable objects identified one-to-one by changed_ids; never the current TransactionRecord itself or StateHead.
The exact generic record_hash of the member identified by record_type and record_id.
The exact checkpoint_hash of StateHead.checkpoint_id's Checkpoint.
The exact head_hash of previous_head_id's predecessor StateHead; null iff previous_head_id is null.

checkpoint_hash.source_bytes: UTF-8 bytes of the NFC-normalized RFC 8785 JCS Checkpoint after exclusions.

head_hash.source_bytes: UTF-8 bytes of the NFC-normalized RFC 8785 JCS StateHead after exclusions.

record_hash.depends_on: The already-computed typed hash when the record type has one.
record_hash.source_bytes: UTF-8 bytes of the NFC-normalized RFC 8785 JCS record after removing only top-level record_hash.

snapshot_hash.source_bytes: UTF-8 bytes of the NFC-normalized RFC 8785 JCS SnapshotManifest after exclusions.

transaction_hash.source_bytes: UTF-8 bytes of the NFC-normalized RFC 8785 JCS TransactionRecord after exclusions.
